mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T3000_ALARM (SENDER_ID, RECEIVER_ID, MESSAGE, URL) VALUES (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{message}, #{url})
mapper.select: SELECT SEQ_NO, SENDER_ID, RECEIVER_ID, MESSAGE, URL, READ_YN, CREATED_DT FROM T3000_ALARM WHERE RECEIVER_ID = #{receiverId} AND CREATED_DT >= SYSDATE - 3 ORDER BY CREATED_DT DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T3000_ALARM WHERE RECEIVER_ID = #{receiverId} AND READ_YN = 'N'
